speaker: staff
text: Thanks for coming in, Sana. Can you tell me a bit about who's at home?

speaker: client
text: Sure. My husband and I have been married for almost twenty years. We have one child, Adam.

speaker: staff
text: And how old are you both, roughly?

speaker: staff
text: How's Adam doing day to day?

speaker: client
text: He has autism, and he needs a lot of help with routines and talking to people. I'm the one who looks after him day to day.

speaker: client
text: We've known since he was a baby, since 2014.

speaker: staff
text: Has anyone ever helped you apply for the Disability Tax Credit for him?

speaker: client
text: No, we've never applied for the Disability Tax Credit. He's never had the disability credit.

speaker: staff
text: Okay. And what does the household bring in, roughly? A range is fine.

speaker: client
text: Our household brings in about fifty-five thousand a year. I'm the only one working, so I make the full fifty-five. My job pays fifty-five thousand before tax.

speaker: staff
text: Are your taxes up to date?

speaker: client
text: We did our taxes for 2025 already, back in the spring. We get the Canada Child Benefit every month.

speaker: staff
text: Do you rent or own, and do you have dental coverage?

speaker: client
text: We rent, it's eighteen hundred a month. Our dental is through my job, so we have private coverage.
